scope.inferenceUnit: paired fresh process mean of 144 measured task durations
scope.clockScope: performance.now() is local to its recorded process; clocks are not joined across processes or hosts
scope.nativeMissingness: jsdom has no native Rust baseline or endpoints; no native counter rows are fabricated
scope.nativeDeltas: numeric endpoint minus its recorded native baseline; cumulative counter deltas alone are not leaks
scope.booleanDeltas: not applicable, represented as an empty CSV cell
scope.innerWarmup: declared rounds are retained; no duration is invented for untimed inner warmup
scope.functionalCoverage: Only the authenticated controller parts are tabulated; standalone worker qualification reports remain in the original ZIPs and are not counted as controller samples
